{{Quote|The ''Falcon''{{'s}} sensors just picked up a deserted moon down there&mdash;we break atmosphere and those ''Star Destroyers'' won't be able to follow us!|Han Solo, to Chewbacca|<ref name="REP" />}}
This '''moon''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] by [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was the site of an abandoned [[Unidentified warehouse (deserted moon)|warehouse]] which contained a contingent of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], along with their [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]].<ref name="REP" />
